criteria.text: Calculates the long-stop date as 20 April 2026 (90 days after signing on 20 January 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 4 June 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.

Identifies that the Fenwick Holdings Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.

Identifies the conflict between the 30-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 60-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 30-day period or aligns the documents.
Gives the long-stop period as 90 days and as the date 20 April 2026, with days remaining from 16 February 2026 (63 days).
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
Shows proposed drafting changes as before/after (current wording vs proposed wording) with a one-line rationale.
